summary: The planning-lock change is the sensitive surface and it is additive: record_files reaches no deny and returns nothing, so no write that would be blocked can pass — the budget and every deny path are unchanged. The record-origin path is preflighted for symlink and out-of-target escape before any write (repository-escape class). forge history is a pure reader proven not to write. The pr-linked event and marker are inert committed data.
residual_risks: The symlinked-.factory guard is the 5th repository-escape finding across client-writing commands; fixed here, it also triggers deferral D-0003 (audit init/adopt/upgrade against the path-boundary invariant with a test per site) rather than being fully closed by this story.
roadmap.json remains a single mutable file that has lost items to merges twice; making it conflict-free like the 0022 ledgers is named as a separate decision, not done here.
